description: L1 public contract checks for the Super Screw TDD adapter only. These checks validate the portable test API surface, action/scenario schema, snapshot envelope, and stable observable fields without inspecting private gameplay implementation.

tool_checks.name: HTML entry exposes a runtime shell
tool_checks.fix_hint: Provide a runnable HTML entry with html, body, and script runtime content.
tool_checks.reason: The L1 runner applies tool checks to the target HTML; the repository separately validates this JSON configuration.

tool_checks.name: Implementation JavaScript has valid Node syntax
tool_checks.fix_hint: Fix implementation JavaScript syntax errors so the L1 runtime check can parse it.
tool_checks.reason: Use the L1 runner's supported JavaScript syntax tool.

checks.name: Public test adapter exposes the TDD method contract
checks.fix_hint: Expose window.__gameTest with reset, input, getSnapshot, and loadScenario as defined by the TDD.
checks.reason: TDD requires a portable window.__gameTest adapter with reset, loadScenario, input, and getSnapshot. The pattern is scoped to the public adapter object, not source-private functions.

checks.name: Adapter returns a snapshot object or ok/snapshot envelope
checks.fix_hint: Return either a direct public Snapshot or an {ok, snapshot, reason?} envelope; do not return only {ok:true}.
checks.reason: The TDD allows direct Snapshot or { ok, snapshot, reason? }, but forbids adapter calls that only return {ok:true}.

checks.name: Public input dispatch recognizes semantic action types
checks.fix_hint: Dispatch semantic player-level action types and required identifiers through __gameTest.input.
checks.reason: TDD action schema is player-level and semantic. This checks contextual dispatch/type-field support instead of bare gameplay words.

checks.name: loadScenario supports legal named preconditions
checks.fix_hint: Support the legal named loadScenario preconditions without pre-applying puzzle outcomes.
checks.reason: Scenario names are public legal preconditions in TDD. The check is scoped to loadScenario rather than private level setup.

checks.name: Snapshot includes state-machine, overlay, revision, and interaction fields
checks.fix_hint: Expose stable phase, screen, result, blocking, interaction, and revision fields in the public snapshot.
checks.reason: Generated implementations must expose stable public state fields from the TDD snapshot schema.

checks.name: Snapshot includes puzzle entities with semantic screen positions
checks.fix_hint: Expose semantic screw, hole, and part entities with IDs, state, screen positions, and target/support metadata.
checks.reason: TDD requires semantic positions and summaries for screws, holes, and parts so L2 can dispatch real input without fixed coordinates.

checks.name: Snapshot exposes controls, panels, tutorial, hint, and tool summaries
checks.fix_hint: Expose the declared controls, panels, tutorial, hint, and tool summaries through the public snapshot.
checks.reason: TDD declares public summaries for auxiliary systems; this checks schema availability without requiring a DOM layout.

checks.name: Rejected public actions expose reason or unchanged-state feedback
checks.fix_hint: Reject invalid actions with a reason/accepted envelope or stable unchanged state without throwing or mutating protected state.
checks.reason: The public contract needs observable rejection semantics for invalid target, busy, locked, empty undo/hint/tool, and panel-blocking paths.
